faq: Which platforms can I move from?
WordPress, Squarespace, Weebly, GoDaddy, Webflow and hand-coded sites are common. Send the link and we check what can be copied automatically and what we rebuild by hand.
Can you move my online store to Wix?
Yes, for small catalogs, as an add-on that moves up to 25 products with images. Larger stores with customer and order history are a bigger job that we quote separately.
A short dip after any move is normal. We reduce the risk by keeping page addresses where we can, redirecting every changed one and copying titles and descriptions. We cannot promise rankings.
Does my old site stop working?
Only when you decide. We build the new site on a Wix address first. When you approve, we point your domain to Wix and you cancel the old hosting yourself.
desc:
Moving your website to Wix means copying your pages, images and posts onto the platform, and keeping old addresses working. Ecom Swift LLC handles the move from WordPress, Squarespace and other builders while your current site stays live.

## What does it mean to move your website to Wix?

Moving a site to Wix means rebuilding your existing content inside a Wix account so you can manage it in the Wix editor. Pages, text, images and blog posts are carried across and laid out to match your old design or a cleaner version of it. Menus, forms and page titles are recreated, and your domain is pointed at the new site when you approve.

The move is more than a copy. Wix and other platforms store content differently, so each page has to be placed by hand and checked for layout, links and images.

## Why do owners move to Wix, and what goes wrong without care?

People switch for simpler editing, fewer plug-ins to update, bundled hosting and a single dashboard for bookings, forms and email. The risk lies in the details. If old addresses are not redirected, search engines and visitors reach error pages. If page titles and descriptions are lost, pages may drop out of search results. If forms are not reconnected, enquiries disappear.

A careful move keeps what has already earned attention and avoids a gap between the old site and the new one.

## How a careful move protects traffic and leads

The key mechanism is the redirect. When an old address permanently points to its new equivalent, visitors and search engines follow the path instead of hitting an error. We build a redirect list and test it. Copying page titles, descriptions and image alt text keeps the signals search engines already know.

Keeping the old site live until the new one is ready means customers never face a blank page or a broken form. Rankings can still change after any move, because search engines reassess a site that has been rebuilt, and we do not promise they will hold. Careful preparation gives them the best chance of recovering quickly.

## What a good migration includes

- An inventory of pages, posts, forms and images before the move starts.
- Text and images copied across and placed on matching pages.
- A layout matched to the old design, or a cleaner version agreed with you.
- Page titles, descriptions and URLs carried over where possible.
- A list of 301 redirects from old addresses to new ones, tested one by one.
- Blog posts imported with dates, images and categories.
- Contact forms and key links reconnected and tested.
- Menus, footer and site structure tidied.
- Domain connection help once you approve the switch.
- A guide to updating Google Search Console after launch.

## What we do

We begin by listing everything on the current site. Next we build the new pages in your Wix account, copy content, set titles and recreate forms. We then prepare the redirect list and test it against the old addresses. Nothing changes for your visitors until you approve the switch.

The Basic package moves a small site with its look kept and its form reconnected. The Standard package covers a larger site with imported blog posts, a redirect check and domain help. The Premium package moves a large site, cleans up image sizes and alt text, improves menus, adds a Search Console guide and includes a period of fixes afterward. Store products can be added as an extra.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Keep your old site and hosting active until the new site is approved.
- Send us a list of pages that matter most.
- Back up your content and images before we start.
- Tell us about any custom features the old site uses.
- Review the new site on a phone and a computer before launch.

**Avoid:**
- Cancelling your old hosting before the switch is complete.
- Changing page names or content on the old site during the move.
- Skipping the redirect check.
- Moving every outdated page without deciding what to keep.
- Sharing passwords, which we never need.

## Who this service is for

- A business tired of updating plug-ins on a self-hosted site.
- A Squarespace or similar builder user who wants Wix tools such as bookings and automations.
- An owner with an old, slow site who wants a fresh start with the same content.
- A blogger who wants posts imported without losing the archive.

## What we need from you

Send your current site address and, where possible, view or collaborator access to the old site so we can export content. Add us as a collaborator in your Wix account. We never need your password. We also need your domain registrar details only when you decide to switch, and we guide you through that step so you stay in control.
